concepts.def: Structured English-like notation independent of language; clarifies algorithm logic before coding.
Diagram with standardised shapes: terminator, process, decision, I/O; ISO 5807 (1985).
Tabular record of variable values at each step; used to debug and verify algorithm behaviour.
Asymptotic upper bound on running time (Bachmann 1894, popularised by Knuth 1976).
Linear search O(n); binary search O(log n) on sorted data; hash lookup O(1) average.
Bubble O(n^2), merge O(n log n) (von Neumann 1945), quicksort O(n log n) average (Hoare 1959).
